# Impulse

> Impulse blocks the apps and websites that steal your focus, so you take back
> 2+ hours a day. Free on iPhone, Android, and as a Chrome and Safari extension.
> A native macOS app is on the way. Website in English (/) and Spanish (/es).

## Overview

Impulse helps people cut unconscious screen time. You choose what to block, when
it is blocked, and how hard it is to get back in. It runs on the phone and on the
computer, and the two are connected: an NFC tap with your phone can end a block
that is running on the desktop.

## Key features

- App and website blocking, instantly or on a schedule (days and time slots)
- Strict blocks that cannot be paused or bypassed until they end
- Time limits per day, in minutes, per site or per app
- Daily opening limits: cap how many times you can open an app, not just for how
  long. Capping openings cuts the automatic reach far earlier than capping
  minutes, and few competing blockers offer it
- Four levels of unlock friction: Easy (type a phrase), Medium (wait out a
  countdown), Hard (an accountability partner holds the code), Physical (tap
  your phone against an NFC tag or the Impulse Disc)
- Physical unlock works with any NFC tag; no proprietary hardware required
- Single-tab mode in the browser: locks you to the current tab
- Quick Focus: start an on-demand focus session with one tap
- Focus Groups: shared rules, streaks and a leaderboard with friends
- Screen time statistics, kept on the device
- Emergency access, deliberately inconvenient, with blocks reactivating after

## The interruption screen

Before letting you into a blocked app, Impulse shows how long you have used it
today and how many times you have already tried to open it. Seeing the opening
count is usually enough to stop the reach.

## Platforms

- iOS app: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/impulse-focus-control-blocker/id6736623036
- Android app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.impulse.es
- Chrome and Safari extension: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/impulse-focus-control-and/ihhgdadeplnooijnccogligfccjpahik
- macOS: native desktop app, coming soon

## Privacy

Usage statistics and block lists stay on the device, not on Impulse servers. No
tracking, no ads, no selling data. On iOS, blocking uses Apple's Screen Time API.

## Pricing

Free to download and use, with no account and no credit card. Impulse Pro is an
optional upgrade for unlimited rules, strict mode and Focus Groups.
